notes: Render-complete modal now previews the finished video at its true aspect ratio. The 'Your video is ready' player was hard-coded to width:100% of a fixed 560px modal with only a max-height cap, so every render — TikTok 9:16, square 1:1, or 16:9 — was forced into the same wide box and portrait videos played tiny inside big black letterbox bars. Now showRenderDoneModal reads the file's real videoWidth/videoHeight on loadedmetadata (pre-sized from getActiveVideoPreset() to avoid a wrong-shape flash) and rdmSizePlayer() sets explicit px width/height matching that ratio, bounded by the viewport (maxH = winH-320 for title/buttons/note; maxW = min(640, winW*0.95-64) so the box fits inside the modal's 28px border-box padding + 95vw cap — fixes a real right-edge overflow). The .rdm-modal shrink-wraps to the player (width:auto, min-width:340, max-width:95vw); .rdm-filename/.rdm-note capped at 380px so the long share-note can't blow the modal wide. Player centers via margin:8px auto, object-fit:contain. A window resize listener (added on open, removed on close) refits live. Verified all three shapes: player ratio matches intrinsic exactly (no letterbox), modal hugs it, no overflow, and play() advances time inside the correctly-shaped area.
